$schema_note: Tracks how we follow kunchenguid/dotfiles for wezterm/nvim/herdr. Live configs live in files/.config/; this file records policy so future upstream updates are reviewable, not blind overwrites.

upstream.mirror_notes: Keep the entire upstream repository available for review. Merge only selected authored configurations into files/; retain our multi-host Nix layout and local additions instead of replacing them.

policies.track: Stay aligned with upstream. Safe auto-apply when our file still matches the last adopted upstream hash.
policies.extend: Upstream is the base; we intentionally added local behavior. Never auto-apply; show a three-way style review (old upstream vs new upstream vs ours).
policies.fork: We own this file. Upstream diffs are inspiration only.

our_additions: Ctrl+Shift+A copy-mode entry and scrollback navigation
Gentle inactive-pane HSB dimming for multi-pane focus clarity
wezterm/wezterm.lua.notes: Minimal WezTerm: rose-pine-moon, Hack Nerd Font, blur, hide tab bar when one tab, RESIZE. No tmux - use WezTerm panes/tabs + herdr for agents.

our_additions: onboarding = false to suppress the first-run prompt
mouse_capture = true for the local trackpad and pane interaction behavior
show_agent_labels_on_pane_borders = false for quieter pane borders
ui.sound.enabled = false to keep the multiplexer silent
herdr/config.toml.notes: Retain Kun's agent_panel_sort = spaces and the rest of his config. The local mouse_capture choice is intentionally different from upstream.

our_additions: markdown-table-wrap.nvim, mini.icons, nvim-treesitter, obsidian.nvim, real-icons.nvim, and render-markdown.nvim pins
nvim/lazy-lock.json.notes: Pin upstream plugin commits while retaining our additional plugin pins.

nvim/lua/keys.lua.notes: Esc saves; Ctrl-A select all; visual paste keeps clipboard.

nvim/lua/vim_config.lua.notes: mouse='' required for herdr Escape behavior.

our_additions: Snacks explorer sidebar and Skim PDF action
Local leader key changes and navigation behavior
nvim/lua/plugins/navigation.lua.notes: Kun's navigation base is retained; local explorer, icon, and PDF workflow additions are intentionally preserved.

howto_add_our_own: Set that file's policy to 'extend' (or 'fork' if you no longer want upstream).
List what you added in our_additions so the next check explains the divergence.
Review; only use --apply for clean 'track' files.
